text:
deploy-bot: Planned shard cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. Affects API, runtime, console, router. Start window 02:00, 20m quiet, rollback window 10m. Please ack if you own a piece.
sanjay: ack. I’ll own runtime-side kv eviction check and kernel pin.
emily: ack. I’ll handle API gateway header-swap and pin the console schema. Will push release notes to #release-notes by EOD.
mike: I can do router traffic-steer and route-table swap. Quick question — are we doing a 50/50 split or progressive 10% increments?
sanjay: prefer progressive 10% x 6 over 12m to watch eviction heat.
emily: +1 progressive. Also we need a fallback model variant for runtime if the quantized path spikes error rate. Suggest fallback -> float16_shim-v2.
tara: noted. I’ll prepare canary eval set and smoke tests. Will run smoke post-10% and full test at 50%.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window 1759994321 created, runbook template: https://internal/runbooks/shard-cutover. Ensure oncall pagers are clear.
sanjay: runtime command to flip kernel path (dry-run):
```bash
./runtime_ctl set-kernel --profile smallseq --variant quant_kv
./runtime_ctl health-check --wait 60
```
(Do not run until we hit 10% and confirm telemetry)
mike: router snippets for traffic-slice:
```json
{"slice": "cutover-2026-03-23", "weights": [10,20,30,40,100]}
```
emily: console pin note: schema v3.4.1 -> pin for 02:00->03:00, keep audit logs verbose. I’ll open a support ticket for customers with sticky pins.
tara: rollback criteria proposal: any p50 latency > 250ms OR error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 3 minutes -> immediate rollback. Also if KV eviction rate > 5% for two consecutive 1m buckets.
sanjay: agree. Add CPU throttling spike > 85% on runtime host group -> rollback.
emily: release-notes draft: "Shard cutover: progressive traffic migration for API/runtime/console/router. Rollback on latency/error/eviction thresholds. Contact oncall@redwood for emergency fallback." Will post in #release-notes in 30m.
mike: I’ll coordinate the route-swap ops and post step confirmations. Plan: 02:00 start, 02:02 10%, 02:04 20%, 02:06 30%, 02:08 40%, 02:10 60%, 02:12 100%.
ops-bot: Canary monitors will notify #eng-sre and page if any threshold breached.
emily: tagging @sanjay @mike @tara for final ack before I pin console schema.
sanjay: final ack from runtime side.
mike: final ack from router.
tara: final ack from QA.
emily: pinned and notes posted: https://internal/release-notes/1759994321
deploy-bot: Deploy window started 1759994321. Good luck :rocket:
ops-bot: Postmortem reminder: capture step timestamps and telemetry slices with tag cutover-1759994321.
emily: if anything unexpected, fallback variant is float16_shim-v2 and full unpin schedule is 02:20->02:30 if rollback required.
sanjay: will watch KV eviction dashboard and shard heatmap. I’ll call rollback if we hit the thresholds.
mike: router will hold at current weight until msg on this thread says proceed.
emily: proceeding when you see the first 10% confirmation.
#automation: 02:02 10% router-slice update complete (simulated message)
mike: 10% confirmed. runtime metrics look stable for 60s.
tara: smoke pass OK.
emily: moving to 20%.
#automation: 02:04 20% router-slice update complete
mike: 20% confirmed. p50 latency +10ms but within threshold.
sanjay: eviction 0.9% -> below threshold.
tara: smoke OK.
emily: moving to 30%.
#automation: 02:06 30% router-slice update complete
mike: 30% confirmed. seeing a small tail in error-rate, 0.6% -> monitoring.
sanjay: runtime CPU on group B trending to 70%. ok so far.
tara: smoke shows one transient fail, re-running.
emily: hold at 30% for 2m to verify.
ops-bot: Hold enforced by conductor. Next automated step paused.
emike: ack, pausing.
sanjay: continuing to watch. Will call rollback if error-rate >0.8% or CPU>85%.
// thread paused for manual verification //
emily: manual check complete, error tail resolved, ok to continue.
mike: proceeding to 40%.
#automation: 02:08 40% router-slice update complete
mike: 40% confirmed. all green.
emily: moving to 60% now.
#automation: 02:10 60% router-slice update complete
mike: 60% confirmed. p50 latency steady.
sanjay: eviction small bump 1.6% but <5%.
tara: full smoke OK.
emily: moving to 100% and final unpin schedule.
#automation: 02:12 100% router-slice update complete
mike: 100% confirmed. cutover complete.
ops-bot: Cutover complete. Closing window. Leave postmortem notes on the release doc.
emily: thanks team. Added a short runbook tweak for future: add an emergency quick-unpin script.
sanjay: will propose a kernel auto-backoff if eviction rises in future.
tara: will attach smoke logs to the release notes.
emike: +1 to automation improvements.
emily: closing thread. :tada:
